inference_scope: Eight frozen latest solver releases, each with an explicit target problem and unchanged native primary scoring. Compare ordinary Codex against the exact content-hashed Algorithm-Space adapter on identical visible inputs, model settings and 4h/8-vCPU/32-GiB budgets. Sol/high and Terra/high each get three fresh starts per condition: 96 starts total. Algorithm modelling and coding use the same model session and total budget; no separate planner budget or extra PitBench hypothesis registration. Retain every attempt, failure and missing measurement. Cross-problem performance is separate transfer evidence. Preserve task-native seed protocols, including deterministic VROOM; CBC and SCIP retain the previously agreed 30 hidden seeds. Only implemented source-bound API dimensions are measured; unavailable capabilities are explicitly reported, never fabricated or scored as success. These tasks reuse the declared benchmark holdouts and do not constitute new untouched workload distributions.

release_pyvrp_v0_14_1.instruction: Improve the pinned solver on capacitated vehicle routing under the declared solve budgets. The original hidden judge_id panel and its native performance protocol define this task's primary objective. Use all supplied public development inputs for diagnosis and regression checks. Cross-problem performance is reported separately as transfer evidence and is not a requirement that every problem becomes faster. Preserve supported-problem feasibility, objective semantics and truthful solve statuses; do not change tests or hardcode instance identities.
